evals.name: refresh-one-seat
evals.prompt: I just pulled the Wheelhouse repository. Apply what changed.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/refresh.sh over the last commit's diff, which reinstalls only wick (ynh install harnesses/wick), and reports that wick is the seat to restart. It reinstalls nothing else and tells the human nothing needs trusting.
assertions: The stub log shows ynh install harnesses/wick
The stub log shows no ynh install for hq, eno or the desk (no ynh install . and no ynh install harnesses/eno)
The reply names wick as the seat to restart, and no other seat
The reply does not say anything needs trusting

evals.name: refresh-workspace-trust
evals.prompt: I just pulled the Wheelhouse repository. Apply what changed.
evals.expected_output: Reinstalls wick, tells the human to run ynh trust accept wick themselves (it never runs it), and says every seat needs a restart because a script changed.
assertions: The stub log shows ynh install harnesses/wick
The reply gives ynh trust accept wick as a command for the human to run
The stub log has no ynh trust call
The reply says every seat (hq, eno and wick) needs a restart because scripts/wake.sh changed

evals.name: refresh-docs-only
evals.prompt: I just pulled the Wheelhouse repository. Apply what changed.
evals.expected_output: Says the pull changed only documentation, so nothing needs reinstalling, trusting or restarting, and runs no ynh install.
assertions: The stub log shows no ynh install
The reply says nothing needs reinstalling, trusting or restarting
The reply does not invent work the diff did not need
